roadmapPosition: Alpha 7.5 combat-cast correction and animation-source preparation

sharedScaleRules.milo: one locked gameplay body scale across idle, run, jump, fall, dash, hurt and every cast direction
sharedScaleRules.standardEnemy: declared body dimensions and feet/hover band; visual effects never alter collision
sharedScaleRules.miniboss: roughly 1.2–1.8× Milo height unless the design deliberately uses a group or horizontal mass
sharedScaleRules.boss: roughly 1.8–2.8× Milo height; spectacle may exceed the body through separate non-collision layers

defectIntake.report: Upward-shooting Milo is too small and has purple clipping at his feet.
defectIntake.artAction: Re-export upward cast at the locked Milo scale; separate palm VFX; enforce feet inset and pivot.
defectIntake.runtimeAction: Verify renderer never applies a state-specific scale.

defectIntake.report: Moving forward while shooting makes Milo too large.
defectIntake.artAction: Match body bounds to idle/run model sheet.
defectIntake.runtimeAction: Remove state-specific sprite scale and preserve collider.

defectIntake.report: Milo appears to float above the floor.
defectIntake.artAction: Lock the visible shoe sole to the common feet baseline.
defectIntake.runtimeAction: Use feet anchor rather than transparent image bounds.

defectIntake.report: Several enemies float; Blade Siren head is cut off; attack forms clip.
defectIntake.artAction: Repack padded fixed cells from separated sources; preserve head/weapon extents.
defectIntake.runtimeAction: Use declared grounded/hover pivots and fixed source rectangles.

defectIntake.report: At least one enemy is too high above the ground.
defectIntake.artAction: Capture exact identity/state before editing; do not shift whole atlases blindly.
defectIntake.runtimeAction: Log enemy id/state/pivot and platform surface on debug screenshot.

defectIntake.artAction: Re-audit attack cells, mouth/tendril effects and transparent inset.
defectIntake.runtimeAction: Confirm source rectangle and phase scale.

defectIntake.artAction: Re-audit phase-two source bounds and effect separation.
Require runtime capture with encounter, state, frame and atlas rectangle before destructive source changes.
